menus.label: Christmas Cake 2026 — advance-order takeaway

items.name: Tart Étoile Le Gall cream-cheese and strawberry tart — 19cm

menus.note: Advance reservation October1 10:00–December15 23:59,2026; may close earlier when sold out. Shinjuku accepts web orders before opening; counter orders only from November28. No telephone reservations. Pickup December19–25; takeaway whole cakes, not a café dine-in set. Prepayment required; online payment by credit card. Cancellation/product or pickup-shop changes only through December6; no refunds or product changes from December7. Pickup-time changes through December15, subject to capacity. Failure to collect during shop hours is nonrefundable; consume on the pickup date. Prices include8% takeaway tax. Limited quantities and fruit substitutions possible. Complimentary ice packs for up to2hours and Christmas cake carry bag; paid cooler bag permits up to4hours. Operator explicitly includes Shinjuku in its 13-shop Christmas reservation programme; linked official selector lists Shinjuku at the matching address. All five product families are alcohol-free except fruit wreath, which uses alcohol for aroma. Published allergen lists should be checked on the operator page. General autumn-menu carousel is shared boilerplate, some items expire before November28, so no unverified opening assortment is copied.
